name: workledger
description: Self-hosted working-time, absence, approval, and monthly-record application.

scripts.workspace:check: pnpm run toolchain:check && node scripts/check-workspace.mjs && node scripts/check-phase-version.mjs
scripts.db:verify: pnpm run db:check && pnpm run db:test
scripts.lint: pnpm run workspace:check && eslint . --max-warnings 0 && node scripts/check-boundaries.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm run workspace:check && pnpm run test:build && node --test scripts/check-workspace.test.mjs scripts/check-boundaries.test.mjs scripts/check-phase-version.test.mjs scripts/check-web-bundle-budget.test.mjs scripts/backup-crypto.test.mjs scripts/backup-restore-contract.test.mjs && vitest run --project unit --project component
scripts.test:integration: pnpm run workspace:check && pnpm run test:build && vitest run --project integration
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run workspace:check && pnpm run test:build && playwright test
scripts.build: pnpm run workspace:check && tsc --build --pretty false --force && pnpm --filter @workledger/web exec vite build && node scripts/check-web-bundle-budget.mjs && node scripts/check-workspace-build.mjs
scripts.verify: pnpm config:check && pnpm openapi:check && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm build
